item.title: Aspirin seldom used to prevent colorectal cancer
item.description: People with Lynch syndrome face a much higher risk of colorectal and other cancers due to an inherited predisposition.

item.title: Safety prompts may guide AI toward safer clinical decisions
item.description: As AI grows more capable of aiding health care tasks, a new study from the Icahn School of Medicine examines how safety prompts influence its choices.

item.title: California medical board power and the 2026 governor's race
item.description: Recently in a Davis residential community, a board member approached a homeowner's door with uncorroborated claims about the homeowner.

item.title: A medical home pioneer experiences fragmented care as a patient
item.description: For years, I discussed the value of coordinated care. Long before the term became popular, I helped build what later became known as the medical home.
